I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

It's a 1280px `#component` on white paper, with a centered 1120px column and your content exactly as given. It has the "Billing" heading, a Team plan card, and an Invoices card with the four rows and Paid pills. It's static HTML and CSS with no JavaScript.

- **Design rules:** I followed `DESIGN.md`. All sizes, spacing, radii and colours come from tokens. The "Change Plan" button is the screen's one primary ink pill, and the table rows are 52px tall.
- **Tokens:** I copied the tokens I used from `tokens.css` into the file's `<style>` block, so it's self-contained.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't in the folder, so they fall back to `system-ui`. The headings will look different until those fonts load.
- **Primary action:** The design rules put the primary action in the top-right of the title row. You specified "Change Plan" inside the plan panel, so I kept it there and left the title row with just the heading.
